dos.text: Await appendNotification()'s returned promise before touching the notification further, it resolves only after the Lit-based moz-message-bar has flushed its update (and, for l10n labels, after document.l10n.translateFragment), so the shadow DOM and alert role aren't guaranteed to exist before that.

donts.text: Don't insert a notification-message element outside the stack a NotificationBox created, its close()/control getter walks up via this.closest(".notificationbox-stack")._notificationBox, a back-reference only set inside NotificationBox's own stack getter, so a manually-placed notification throws when closed.

Don't give a button a popup id and expect a graceful no-op if it's wrong, setButtons calls document.getElementById(popup).openPopup(...) directly with no null check, so a missing popup id throws at click time.
